item.text:
Updated the assistant content flow so the composer’s `messageID` reaches model preparation, result rendering, and editor insertion. URL placeholders now restore only for their originating message; unknown or mismatched links lose their URL but keep their visible content, and unmatched images are removed. Link and image `class` and `style` attributes survive the HTML and Markdown round trip. The new [fixNestedLists](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/assistant/markdown.ts) repairs invalid list nesting, and assistant Markdown now renders lists and preserves code block spacing.

I delegated the Markdown, URL, and call-site changes to three native agents, then integrated and verified them. The focused tests passed (16 tests), as did the existing composer and message content tests (6 tests), ESLint, Prettier, and the diff check. Mail type checking found no errors in changed files; it still reports an OpenPGP type mismatch in `packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts`.
